question: How can I switch my account from temporary to regular?

sections.beforeHtml: You have different options depending on which plan you choose and whether you want to save temporary test data. If you are not signed in go to the <a href="/">main page<a> and choose a plan.
items: To switch to a paid plan (recommended) and keep your test data, go to your profile and click "Change plan" button. Choose a plan, and click "Upgrade to Monthly" or "Upgrade to Yearly". The "Secure checkout" form appears. Enter your actual email and click "Proceed". You will be redirected to a payments processing page. Fill up the form and click "Subscribe". After successful payment and subscription creation you will be redirected back to Plantour Sign In page. Sign in with your email.

If you wish to switch to a free plan and keep your test data go to your profile and enter your real email instead of currenly used Robin.Miles.XXXYYY@plantour.app, then click "Sign in / Sign up" button.
